# Planted skill

Every defect the skill_frontmatter check looks for, in one place: a `name` that
disagrees with the directory, a misspelled `requires-tool`, a description that
never says when to use it, an over-long reference with no contents list in
`references/long.md`, and a reference that points onward in `references/hop.md`.
